title: Exact Half-Angle Evaluation Using Power-Reduction
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Use the half-angle formula for cosine to determine the exact value of cos(pi/8).

steps.title: State the Half-Angle Formula
steps.explanation: Set theta = pi/4 so that theta/2 = pi/8.
steps.why: Power-reduction identity derived directly from the double-angle cosine formula.

steps.title: Substitute Known Exact Values
steps.explanation: Substitute cos(pi/4) = sqrt(2)/2 and simplify the compound fraction by multiplying numerator and denominator by 2.
steps.why: Evaluation of standard special angle pi/4 on the unit circle.

steps.title: Take the Principal Square Root
steps.explanation: Since pi/8 lies in Quadrant I (0 < pi/8 < pi/2), the cosine value must be positive, choosing the positive square root.
steps.why: Cosine is strictly positive in the first quadrant.
